text:
jordan: quick async — morning shiproom check-in.

what I did: finished the 'replay-mode' rollout spec (https://rwd.internal/rfc/replay-mode). includes replaying request/response pairs for production regression checks and a lightweight validation step.

blockers: need a QA harness for prompt-regression tests (golden outputs), and final signoff on the rollback policy for model-variant fallbacks.

today: pair with tanvi on canary plan, hand off canary scripts to eng, ping QA for regression runs.

mika: looked through the spec — nice work. couple tiny nits around event names for tracing and an explicit metric for model-fallback-rate. will add comments in the doc. :eyes:

tanvi: ack, can pair at 10:30am PST. I can own the canary traffic steps and the runbook for rollback. question: do we want auto-fallback to a cheaper variant, or manual only? cc @ben

ben: we have a manual fallback implemented today. I'll draft an emergency auto-fallback rule but prefer it gated behind a flag for the first rollout. will PR it.

carla: QA here — we can run the regression harness but need the sample prompt set + golden outputs to validate. also add a test for streaming truncation when tokens are cut off mid-response.

jordan: pasted a short prompt list below (we'll push full set to the RFC):
- "summarize product notes for billing integration"
- "rewrite user-facing error to be friendly and include steps"
- "extract entities: org, project, owner from support ticket"

also notes for streaming test: simulate partial KV cache warmup and truncated final chunk.

---

sample canary run command (devtools):
```
# run canary with 1% traffic, record fallback events
./canary-runner --model=variant-a --traffic=0.01 --record-events=fallback,latency
```

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-runner v0.3 -> namespace shiproom at 11:15 UTC. :rocket:

mika: one more spec nit — clarify KV cache warmup timeout. suggest default 2s and make it configurable per-model.

tanvi: added the timeout note to the doc. also propose rollout priority: latency SLO first, cost knobs second for initial canary.

ben: opening two PRs: (1) canary-runner script changes, (2) emergency auto-fallback flag + basic heuristics. target: EOD. will request reviews from mika and tanvi.

carla: QA will pick up after PR merges. optimistic ETA: tomorrow 09:00 PT to have regression runs and a short report.

jordan: great — sounds like a plan. any remaining blockers? if not, I'll mark this as handoff and schedule a 15m sync only if QA finds regressions. :thumbsup:

mika: no blockers from product side.

tanvi: none from infra; will message if canary timing shifts.

ben: will post PR links here when ready.

carla: will post results here after runs.

jordan: thanks team — marking this thread resolved for async handoff."
